messages:
emily.design: dropped a new compact-row mock for the latency panel. main question: inline funnel icon next to the scrubber (one-tap access) or hide sampling under the kebab menu to keep the toolbar minimal? wondering which balances discoverability and visual noise best. :mag:

tonay.eng: inline funnel wins for discovery. most users look right at the scrubber first. downside: on very narrow widths it nudges the scrubber and can overlap the time chips. dev note: our current prefs are dashboard-level only, so per-chart will be a schema change.

carla.pm: from field interviews, people repeatedly asked whether sampling changes p95. we need explicit microcopy: short line like "Sampling reduces visual points; metrics (p50/p95) remain full-accuracy unless you enable 'Lower metrics precision'."

sam.a11y: accessibility checklist: funnel icon must have aria-label="Open sampling options for Heatmap"; popover role=dialog and trap focus; switch needs aria-describedby pointing to help text. don't rely on color alone to show on/off  add text "Sampling: On/Off" and an icon. slider needs aria-valuemin="5", aria-valuemax="100", aria-valuenow and aria-live="polite". ensure tap targets >=44px. also contrast: the p95 badge on dark fails AA at #6b5ad1 on #0e0e11; propose #a48ff8 or 1px outline.

emily.design: thanks  i'll add the short help line under the popover and ensure the breadcrumb "Applies to: Heatmap" is visible. for compact default we can show a tiny funnel (24px) that opens a popover with: On/Off, slider(5-100, step=5), short help, and a docs link.

tonay.eng: dev feasibility: implement UI with local state; persist per-chart only behind feature flag `feature:per_chart_sampling`. perf prototype shows a ~20-30ms render bump when per-chart reads are enabled; we'll A/B test. will throttle slider updates with rAF.

carla.pm: telemetry requirements: events: `sampling.opened`, `sampling.toggled`, `sampling.rate_changed`, `sampling.scope` (global|chart), `sampling.help_clicked`. rollout behind feature flag and enable for canary orgs.

sam.a11y: one more nit: ensure the popover is dismissible with Escape and clicking outside returns focus to the funnel icon. add aria-live region for the slider value announcements.

emily.design: got it. mock updated: https://tiny.redwood/compact-funnel-v1. shortened help copy to the suggested line and added textual state. will include a11y checklist in the component spec.

ux-bot: created ticket #4982 "Compact funnel popover for per-chart sampling + accessibility checklist" assigned to tony.eng, due 2024-09-15.
